case.title: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation. Need: 23400 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 22230. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Your offer gives us a clear starting point. Option A below answers what matters most to a supplier with tight capacity: a binding volume over a long term, so that you can plan your seal allocation with us in full.

On the cost side:
Our cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010).

On quality:
Your quality was 270 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70410@2026Q3).

On price history:
Our orders of Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM with you were placed at EUR 29.89 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011517-10), EUR 29.89 on 2025-05-19 (po:4500012472-10), EUR 29.89 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013451-10) and EUR 29.89 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014436-10): the price has been unchanged.

Option A is the package we can approve. It commits us to the full volume for the whole contract term, and the price reflects that security and the reliable record on both sides.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 28.50; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 36 months; lead time 42 days.
Binding volume in every option: 23,400 units a year over 36 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Since a change of this size may need your pricing committee, here is a short paragraph you can take to it as it stands: Option A gives Ravensteiner a binding annual volume over a long contract term, a shorter lead time, and a customer that plans its seal demand around you. We would be grateful if you would take Option A to the committee.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the quality record data, the price history data, and the should cost data you cited. The data holds, and we took the should cost data into account, but the quality record and price history do not change our calculation.

We accept the proposed volume of 23,400 units and the 36-month contract term. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Ourangebot contains a price of €33.60 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.

Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 54 days: €31.70 per unit. Due to our high capacity utilization, we must maintain the lead time at 54 days to ensure reliable delivery for a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.

Which volume can you commit to? This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Legal Department: Please be advised that our general terms and conditions apply exclusively, and the quote lists our standard terms.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for confirming the volume and the contract term. A binding commitment over the full term is what lets you plan your seal allocation with us, and Option A gives you exactly that.

We accept your alternative proposal as offered, the one that keeps your lead time, so that your deliveries stay reliable under your high capacity utilization. Option A is the package we can approve:

Our proposal: unit price EUR 31.70; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 36 months; lead time 56 days.
Binding volume in every option: 23,400 units a year over 36 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

For your pricing committee or management, in plain words: Option A secures the full binding volume with you for the whole contract term, at a price on your own terms, and with a lead time your capacity can support. It is a firm, long-term plan with a reliable partner.

We would be grateful if you would take Option A to your committee as it stands.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We note your acceptance of our pricing of €31.70 per unit and the Lieferzeit 56 days. This concludes the negotiation for a volume of 23400 pcs per year over a contract term of 36 months. 

We can accept your terms and await your order. We will process the order confirmation accordingly. Our Angebot stays valid for 14 days. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
